insight: Pivoted from consumer Google-rival to enterprise — its ARI research agent and APIs now lead, priced per report rather than per compute-hour.
name: You.com
tagline: Multi-model AI search and enterprise research agents.
description: You.com is an AI search and answers product offering multi-model chat over OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google models on web and mobile. It has shifted toward enterprise with ARI, a research agent that synthesizes cited reports across hundreds of sources, alongside Search and Research APIs for developers.

modelSupport.notes: Pro users pick a provider per query; APIs expose search and research.
